name: Open Kitchen
description: Open-source restaurant & central-kitchen back-of-house software — a self-hostable alternative to Apicbase, MarketMan and Craftable. Owns the kitchen cost graph (ingredients, supplier prices, recipes and sub-recipe preps, food cost, inventory counts, production runs, supplier invoices) and tracks licenses, permits, leases and HACCP certificates with expiry reminders. Invoice scanning, sales forecasting and the daily P&L narrative are done by your Clawnify agent over the app's JSON API — the app is the system of record, the agent is the system of action, reachable on WhatsApp and email.

deploy.title: Deploy your kitchen back office
deploy.subtitle: Like Apicbase or MarketMan — recipes, food cost & inventory, run by an agent
